framework.note: Mandatory disclosure threshold when acquirer crosses 5% shareholding; defines 'acquirer' and triggers OPA at 25%.
Post-acquisition disclosure requirement within 24 hours of crossing threshold; filed by acquirer to stock exchanges and target company.
Triggers mandatory open offer obligation at 25% or higher acquisition of shares.
Restricts trading by acquirer and concert parties during disclosure window and OPA period.
Provides stock exchange authority to enforce takeover code and suspend trading if non-compliance.
Defines substantial acquisition thresholds and concert-party norms; merger/amalgamation clauses if OPA results in delisting.

headline: Plutus Wealth Management LLP discloses substantial acquisition in Nazara Technologies under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Plutus Wealth Management LLP filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition move in listed gaming and e-sports platform Nazara Technologies Limited.
detail: Plutus Wealth Management LLP, a non-bank financial entity, submitted a formal SEBI Takeover Code disclosure under Regulation 31(4) to NSE on 3 July 2026 regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Nazara Technologies, a publicly listed gaming and esports company headquartered in Mumbai. The filing initiates the statutory disclosure cascade: immediate intimation to the target, the stock exchanges, and the public under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The exact quantum of shares acquired and the acquirer's intent (full OPA, strategic stake, or concert-party role) will be specified in the detailed disclosure document.
